# banandre.com

> > A hybrid resource combining TV Guide's comprehensive television listings with Know Your Meme's viral internet culture documentation.

This site aggregates entertainment content from two major sources: TV Guide for live TV schedules, streaming recommendations, and sports listings, and Know Your Meme for trending memes, viral videos, and internet culture explainers primarily from TikTok, Twitter/X, and Reddit.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- TV schedules and live sports listings
- Viral meme explanations and internet slang
- Catchphrase memes and exploitables
- Know Your Meme documentation
- TV Guide entertainment news
- Streaming service recommendations
- Reddit and Twitter/X viral content
- Dance memes and TikTok challenges
- Celebrity and entertainment news
- Local TV listings by zip code
- Image macros and reaction memes
- Breaking Bad and pop culture references
- Mental health and relatable humor
- Conspiracy theories and debunking

## TV Listings & Entertainment

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage: streaming recommendations, TV reviews & entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule listings for shows, movies & programs across all providers
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, UEFA, ACC across all networks
- [Cary, NC TV Guide - Tonight's Antenna, Cable or Satellite TV Schedule - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/27518-cary-nc): Local TV schedule for Cary, NC antenna/cable/satellite providers
- [Navarre, FL TV Guide - Tonight's Antenna, Cable or Satellite TV Schedule - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/32566-navarre-fl): Local TV schedule for Navarre, FL antenna/cable/satellite providers
